verdict.rationale: Vue's official docs include a dedicated "Migration from Vue 2" guide, which is exactly an official upgrade path for existing projects. A community comment also praises how the Vue 3 redesign kept existing users happy, loosely corroborating the upgrade experience. The evidence is only a link title, though, so the guide's depth is not shown. Missing for 10: evidence of the guide's actual content (breaking-change lists, step-by-step instructions, migration build/tooling), hands-on reports of following the guide successfully, coverage of minor-version upgrades beyond the 2→3 jump.
